pli-tv-kd20:1.1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sakkesu viharati Kapilavatthusmiṃ Nigrodhārāme.
pli-tv-kd20:1.1.2: atha kho Mahāpajāpatī Gotamī yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi,
pli-tv-kd20:1.1.3: ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho Mahāpajāpatī Gotamī bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd20:1.1.4: sādhu bhante labheyya mātugāmo tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjan ti.
pli-tv-kd20:1.1.5: alaṃ Gotami mā te rucci mātugāmassa tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd20:1.1.7: kho Mahāpajāpatī Gotamī bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd20:1.1.9: alaṃ Gotami mā te . . . pabbajjā 'ti. tatiyam pi kho Mahāpajāpatī . . . pabbajjan ti. alaṃ Gotami mā te . . . pabbajjā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd20:1.1.11: na bhagavā anujānāti mātugāmassa tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjan ti
pli-tv-kd20:1.1.12: dukkhī dummanā assumukhī rudamānā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi. ||1||
pli-tv-kd20:1.2.1: atha kho bhagavā Kapilavatthusmiṃ yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā yena Vesālī tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi,
pli-tv-kd20:1.2.2: anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena Vesālī tad avasari.
pli-tv-kd20:1.2.3: tatra sudaṃ bhagavā Vesāliyaṃ viharati Mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
pli-tv-kd20:1.2.4: atha kho Mahāpajāpatī Gotamī kese chedāpetvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā sambahulāhi Sākiyānīhi saddhiṃ yena Vesālī tena pakkāmi,
pli-tv-kd20:1.2.5: anupubbena yena Vesālī Mahāvanaṃ kūtāgārasālā ten' upasaṃkami.
pli-tv-kd20:1.2.6: atha kho Mahāpajāpatī Gotamī sunehi pādehi rajokiṇṇena gattena dukkhī dummanā assumukhī rudamānā bahi dvārakoṭṭhake aṭṭhāsi.
pli-tv-kd20:1.2.7: addasā kho āyasmā Ānando Mahāpajāpatiṃ Gotamiṃ sunehi pādehi rajokiṇṇena gattena dukkhiṃ dummanaṃ assumukhiṃ rudamānaṃ bahi dvārakoṭṭhake ṭhitaṃ,
pli-tv-kd20:1.2.9: kissa tvaṃ Gotami sunehi pādehi . . . rudamānā bahi dvārakoṭṭhake ṭhitā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd20:1.2.10: tathā hi pana bhante Ānanda na bhagavā anujānāti mātugāmassa tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjan ti.
pli-tv-kd20:1.2.11: tena hi Gotami muhuttaṃ idh' eva tāva hohi yāvāhaṃ bhagavantaṃ yācāmi mātugāmassa tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjan ti. ||2||
pli-tv-kd20:1.3.1: atha kho āyasmā Ānando yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi,
pli-tv-kd20:1.3.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Ānando bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd20:1.3.3: esā bhante Mahāpajāpatī Gotamī sunehi pādehi . . . rudamānā bahi dvārakoṭṭhake ṭhitā
pli-tv-kd20:1.3.4: na bhagavā anujānāti mātugāmassa tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjan ti:
pli-tv-kd20:1.3.5: sādhu bhante labheyya mātugāmo tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjan ti.
pli-tv-kd20:1.3.6: alaṃ Ānanda mā te rucci mātugāmassa tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd20:1.3.8: kho āyasmā Ānando bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd20:1.3.10: alaṃ Ānanda mā . . . pabbajjā 'ti. tatiyam pi kho āyasmā Ānando bhagavantaṃ . . . pabbajjan ti. alaṃ Ānanda mā . . . pabbajjā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd20:1.3.12: na bhagavā anujānāti mātugāmassa tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjaṃ,
pli-tv-kd20:1.3.13: yan nūnāhaṃ aññena pi pariyāyena bhagavantaṃ yāceyyaṃ mātugāmassa . . . pabbajjan ti.
pli-tv-kd20:1.3.14: atha kho āyasmā Ānando bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd20:1.3.15: bhabbo nu kho bhante mātugāmo tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitvā sotāpattiphalaṃ vā sakadāgāmiphalaṃ vā anāgāmiphalaṃ vā arahattaṃ vā sacchikātun ti.
pli-tv-kd20:1.3.16: bhabbo Ānanda mātugāmo tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitvā sotāpattiphalam pi sakadāgāmiphalam pi anāgāmiphalam pi arahattam pi sacchikātun ti.
pli-tv-kd20:1.3.17: sace bhante bhabbo mātugāmo tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye . . . arahattam pi sacchikātuṃ,
pli-tv-kd20:1.3.18: bahūpakārā bhante Mahāpajāpatī Gotamī bhagavato mātucchā āpādikā posikā khīrassa dāyikā bhagavantaṃ janettiyā kālaṃkatāya thaññaṃ pāyesi:
pli-tv-kd20:1.3.19: sādhu bhante labheyya mātugāmo tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjan ti. ||3||
pli-tv-kd20:1.4.1: sace Ānanda Mahāpajāpatī Gotamī aṭṭha garudhamme paṭigaṇhāti sā 'v' assā
pli-tv-kd20:1.4.3: vassasatupasampannāya bhikkhuniyā tadahupasampannassa bhikkhuno abhivādanaṃ paccuṭṭhānaṃ añjalikammaṃ sāmīcikammaṃ kātabbaṃ;
pli-tv-kd20:1.4.4: ayam pi dhammo sakkatvā garukatvā mānetvā pūjetvā yāvajīvaṃ anatikkamanīyo.
pli-tv-kd20:1.4.5: na bhikkhuniyā abhikkhuke āvāse vassaṃ vasitabbaṃ;
pli-tv-kd20:1.4.7: anvaddhamāsaṃ bhikkhuniyā bhikkhusaṃghato dve dhammā paccāsiṃsitabbā
pli-tv-kd20:1.4.10: vassaṃ vutthāya bhikkhuniyā ubhatosaṃghe tīhi ṭhānehi pavāretabbaṃ
pli-tv-kd20:1.4.11: diṭṭhena vā sutena vā parisaṅkāya vā;
pli-tv-kd20:1.4.13: garudhammaṃ ajjhāpannāya bhikkhuniyā ubhatosaṃghe pakkhamānattaṃ caritabbaṃ;
pli-tv-kd20:1.4.15: dve vassāni chasu dhammesu sikkhitasikkhāya sikkhamānāya ubhatosaṃghe upasampadā pariyesitabbā;
pli-tv-kd20:1.4.17: na bhikkhuniyā kenaci pariyāyena bhikkhu akkositabbo paribhāsitabbo;
pli-tv-kd20:1.4.19: ajjatagge ovaṭo bhikkhunīnam bhikkhūsu vacanapatho, anovaṭo bhikkhūnaṃ bhikkhunīsu vacanapatho;
pli-tv-kd20:1.4.21: sace Ānanda Mahāpajāpatī Gotamī ime aṭṭha garudhamme paṭigaṇhāti sā 'v' assā hotu upasampadā 'ti. ||4||
pli-tv-kd20:1.5.1: atha kho āyasmā Ānando bhagavato santike aṭṭha garudhamme uggahetvā yena Mahāpajāpatī Gotamī ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā Mahāpajāpatiṃ Gotamiṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd20:1.5.2: sace kho tvaṃ Gotami aṭṭha garudhamme paṭigaṇheyyāsi sā 'va te bhavissati upasampadā:
pli-tv-kd20:1.5.21: sace kho tvaṃ Gotami ime aṭṭha garudhamme paṭigaṇheyyāsi sā 'va te bhavissati upasampadā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd20:1.5.22: seyyathāpi bhante Ānanda itthi vā puriso vā daharo yuvā maṇḍanajātiko sīsaṃ nahāto uppalamālaṃ vā vassikamālaṃ vā atimuttakamālaṃ vā labhitvā ubhohi hatthehi paṭiggahetvā uttamaṅge sirasmiṃ patiṭṭhāpeyya,
pli-tv-kd20:1.5.23: evam eva kho ahaṃ bhante Ānanda ime aṭṭha garudhamme paṭigaṇhāmi yāvajīvaṃ anatikkamanīye 'ti. ||5||
pli-tv-kd20:1.6.1: atha kho āyasmā Ānando yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi,
pli-tv-kd20:1.6.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Ānando bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd20:1.6.3: paṭiggahitā bhante Mahāpajāpatigotamiyā aṭṭha garudhammā, upasampannā bhagavato mātucchā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd20:1.6.4: sace Ānanda nālabhissa mātugāmo tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjaṃ, ciraṭṭhitikaṃ Ānanda brahmacariyaṃ abhavissa, vassasahassaṃ saddhammo tiṭṭheyya.
pli-tv-kd20:1.6.5: yato ca kho Ānanda mātugāmo tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito, na dāni Ānanda brahmacariyaṃ ciraṭṭhitikaṃ bhavissati,
pli-tv-kd20:1.6.6: pañc' eva dāni Ānanda vassasatāni saddhammo ṭhassati.
pli-tv-kd20:1.6.7: seyyathāpi Ānanda yāni kānici kulāni bahutthikāni appapurisakāni tāni suppadhaṃsiyāni honti corehi kumbhatthenakehi,
pli-tv-kd20:1.6.8: evam eva kho Ānanda yasmiṃ dhammavinaye labhati mātugāmo agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjaṃ na taṃ brahmacariyaṃ ciraṭṭhitikaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-kd20:1.6.9: seyyathāpi Ānanda sampanne sālikkhette setaṭṭhikā nāma rogajāti nipatati evan taṃ sālikkhettaṃ na ciraṭṭhitikaṃ hoti,
pli-tv-kd20:1.6.10: evam eva kho Ānanda yasmiṃ dhammavinaye labhati mātugāmo agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjaṃ na taṃ brahmacariyaṃ ciraṭṭhitikaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-kd20:1.6.11: seyyathāpi Ānanda sampanne ucchukkhette mañjeṭṭhikā nāma rogajāti nipatati evan taṃ ucchukkhettaṃ na ciraṭṭhitikaṃ hoti,
pli-tv-kd20:1.6.12: evam eva kho Ānanda yasmiṃ . . . hoti.
pli-tv-kd20:1.6.13: seyyathāpi Ānanda puriso mahato taḷākassa paṭigacc' eva ālim bandheyya yāvad eva udakassa anatikkamanāya,
pli-tv-kd20:1.6.14: evam eva kho Ānanda mayā paṭigacc' eva bhikkhunīnaṃ aṭṭha garudhammā paññattā yāvajīvaṃ anatikkamanīyā 'ti. ||6||1||
pli-tv-kd20:2.1.1: atha kho Mahāpajāpatī Gotamī yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi,
pli-tv-kd20:2.1.2: ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho Mahāpajāpatī Gotamī bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd20:2.1.4: atha kho bhagavā Mahāpajāpatiṃ Gotamiṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi . . . sampahaṃsesi.
pli-tv-kd20:2.1.5: atha kho Mahāpajāpatī Gotamī bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya sandassitā . . . sampahaṃsitā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd20:2.1.6: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd20:2.1.7: anujānāmi bhikkhave bhikkhūhi bhikkhuniyo upasampādetun ti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd20:2.2.1: atha kho tā bhikkhuniyo Mahāpajāpatiṃ Gotamiṃ etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd20:2.2.3: evaṃ hi bhagavatā paññattaṃ: bhikkhūhi bhikkhuniyo upasampādetabbā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd20:2.2.4: atha kho Mahāpajāpatī Gotamī yenāyasmā Ānando ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi,
pli-tv-kd20:2.2.5: ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho Mahāpajāpatī Gotamī āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd20:2.2.6: imā maṃ bhante Ānanda bhikkhuniyo evam āhaṃsu:
pli-tv-kd20:2.2.8: evaṃ hi bhagavatā paññattaṃ: bhikkhūhi bhikkhuniyo upasampādetabbā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd20:2.2.9: atha kho āyasmā Ānando yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi,
pli-tv-kd20:2.2.10: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Ānando bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd20:2.2.15: yadaggena Ānanda Mahāpajāpatigotamiyā aṭṭha garudhammā paṭiggahitā, tad eva sā upasampannā 'ti. ||2||2||
pli-tv-kd20:3.1.1: atha kho Mahāpajāpatī Gotamī yenāyasmā Ānando ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi,
pli-tv-kd20:3.1.2: ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho Mahāpajāpatī Gotamī āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd20:3.1.3: ekāhaṃ bhante Ānanda bhagavantaṃ varaṃ yācāmi:
pli-tv-kd20:3.1.4: sādhu bhante bhagavā anujāneyya bhikkhūnañ ca bhikkhunīnañ ca yathāvuḍḍhaṃ abhivādanaṃ paccuṭṭhānaṃ añjalikammaṃ sāmīcikamman ti.
pli-tv-kd20:3.1.5: atha kho āyasmā Ānando yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi,
pli-tv-kd20:3.1.6: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Ānando bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd20:3.1.10: aṭṭhānam etaṃ Ānanda anavakāso yaṃ tathāgato anujāneyya mātugāmassa abhivādanaṃ paccuṭṭhānaṃ añjalikammaṃ sāmīcikammaṃ.
pli-tv-kd20:3.1.11: ime hi nāma Ānanda aññatitthiyā durakkhātadhammā mātugāmassa abhivādanaṃ paccuṭṭhānaṃ añjalikammaṃ sāmīcikammaṃ na karissanti,
pli-tv-kd20:3.1.12: kim aṅga pana tathāgato anujānissati mātugāmassa abhivādanaṃ paccuṭṭhānaṃ añjalikammaṃ sāmīcikamman ti.
pli-tv-kd20:3.1.13: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd20:3.1.14: na bhikkhave mātugāmassa abhivādanaṃ paccuṭṭhānaṃ añjalikammaṃ sāmīcikammaṃ kātabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd20:4.1.1: atha kho Mahāpajāpatī Gotamī yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi,
pli-tv-kd20:4.1.2: ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho Mahāpajāpatī Gotamī bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd20:4.1.3: yāni tāni bhante bhikkhunīnaṃ sikkhāpadāni bhikkhūhi sādhāraṇāni kathaṃ mayaṃ bhante tesu sikkhāpadesu paṭipajjāmā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd20:4.1.4: yāni tāni Gotami bhikkhunīnaṃ sikkhāpadāni bhikkhūhi sādhāraṇāni yathā bhikkhū sikkhanti tathā tesu sikkhāpadesu sikkhathā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd20:4.1.5: yāni pana tāni bhante bhikkhunīnaṃ sikkhāpadāni bhikkhūhi asādhāraṇāni kathaṃ mayaṃ bhante tesu sikkhāpadesu paṭipajjāmā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd20:4.1.6: yāni tāni Gotami bhikkhunīnaṃ sikkhāpadāni bhikkhūhi asādhāraṇāni yathāpaññattesu sikkhāpadesu sikkhathā 'ti. ||4||
pli-tv-kd20:5.1.1: atha kho Mahāpajāpatī Gotamī yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi,
pli-tv-kd20:5.1.2: ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho Mahāpajāpatī Gotamī bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd20:5.1.3: sādhu bhante bhagavā saṃkhittena dhammaṃ desetu yam ahaṃ bhagavato dhammaṃ sutvā ekā vūpakaṭṭhā appamattā ātāpinī pahitattā vihareyyan ti.
pli-tv-kd20:5.1.4: ye kho tvaṃ Gotami dhamme jāneyyāsi:
pli-tv-kd20:5.1.5: ime dhammā sārāgāya saṃvattanti no virāgāya, saññogāya saṃvattanti no visaññogāya, ācayāya saṃvattanti no apacayāya, mahicchatāya saṃvattanti no appicchatāya, asantuṭṭhiyā saṃvattanti no santuṭṭhiyā, saṃgaṇikāya saṃvattanti no pavivekāya, kosajjāya saṃvattanti no viriyārambhāya, dubbharatāya saṃvattanti no subharatāya:
pli-tv-kd20:5.1.7: n' eso dhammo n' eso vinayo n' etaṃ satthu sāsanan ti.
pli-tv-kd20:5.1.8: ye ca kho tvaṃ Gotami dhamme jāneyyāsi:
pli-tv-kd20:5.1.9: ime dhammā virāgāya saṃvattanti no sārāgāya, visaññogāya saṃvattanti no saññogāya, apacayāya saṃvattanti no ācayāya, appicchatāya saṃvattanti no mahicchatāya, santuṭṭhiyā saṃvattanti no asantuṭṭhiyā, pavivekāya saṃvattanti no saṃgaṇikāya, viriyārambhāya saṃvattanti no kosajjāya, subharatāya saṃvattanti no dubbharatāya:
pli-tv-kd20:5.1.11: eso dhammo eso vinayo etaṃ satthu sāsanan ti. ||5||
pli-tv-kd20:6.1.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhunīnaṃ pātimokkhaṃ na uddisiyati.
pli-tv-kd20:6.1.3: anujānāmi bhikkhave bhikkhunīnaṃ pātimokkhaṃ uddisitun ti.
pli-tv-kd20:6.1.5: kena nu kho bhikkhunīnaṃ pātimokkhaṃ uddisitabban ti.
pli-tv-kd20:6.1.7: anujānāmi bhikkhave bhikkhūhi bhikkhunīnaṃ pātimokkhaṃ uddisitun ti.
pli-tv-kd20:6.1.8: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū bhikkhunūpassayaṃ upasaṃkamitvā bhikkhunīnaṃ pātimokkhaṃ uddisanti.
pli-tv-kd20:6.1.10: jāyāyo imā imesaṃ, jāriyo imā imesaṃ, idān' ime imāhi saddhiṃ abhiramissantīti. assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ. atha kho te bhikkhū
pli-tv-kd20:6.1.12: na bhikkhave bhikkhūhi bhikkhunīnaṃ pātimokkhaṃ uddisitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd20:6.1.14: anujānāmi bhikkhave bhikkhunīhi bhikkhunīnaṃ pātimokkhaṃ uddisitun ti.
pli-tv-kd20:6.2.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhuniyo āpattiṃ na paṭikaronti.
pli-tv-kd20:6.2.3: na bhikkhave bhikkhuniyā āpatti na paṭikātabbā.
pli-tv-kd20:6.2.11: kena nu kho bhikkhunīnaṃ āpatti paṭiggahetabbā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd20:6.2.13: anujānāmi bhikkhave bhikkhūhi bhikkhunīnaṃ āpattiṃ paṭiggahetun ti.
pli-tv-kd20:6.2.14: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhuniyo rathiyāpi vyūhe pi siṅghāṭake pi bhikkhuṃ passitvā pattaṃ bhūmiyaṃ nikkhipitvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā āpattiṃ paṭikaronti.
pli-tv-kd20:6.2.16: jāyāyo imā imesaṃ, jāriyo imā imesaṃ, rattiṃ vimānetvā idāni khamāpentīti.
pli-tv-kd20:6.2.18: na bhikkhave bhikkhūhi bhikkhunīnaṃ āpatti paṭiggahetabbā.
pli-tv-kd20:6.2.20: anujānāmi bhikkhave bhikkhunīhi bhikkhunīnaṃ āpattiṃ paṭiggahetun ti.
pli-tv-kd20:6.3.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhunīnaṃ kammaṃ na kariyati.
pli-tv-kd20:6.3.3: anujānāmi bhikkhave bhikkhunīnaṃ kammaṃ kātun ti.
pli-tv-kd20:6.3.5: kena nu kho bhikkhunīnaṃ kammaṃ kātabban ti.
pli-tv-kd20:6.3.7: anujānāmi bhikkhave bhikkhūhi bhikkhunīnaṃ kammaṃ kātun ti.
pli-tv-kd20:6.3.8: tena kho pana samayena katakammā bhikkhuniyo rathiyāpi vyūhe pi siṅghāṭake pi bhikkhuṃ passitvā pattaṃ bhūmiyaṃ nikkhipitvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā khamāpenti evaṃ nūna kātabban ti maññamānā.
pli-tv-kd20:6.3.9: manussā tath' eva ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-kd20:6.3.10: jāyāyo imā imesaṃ, jāriyo imā imesaṃ, rattiṃ vimānetvā idāni khamāpentīti.
pli-tv-kd20:6.3.12: na bhikkhave bhikkhūhi bhikkhunīnaṃ kammaṃ kātabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd20:6.3.14: anujānāmi bhikkhave bhikkhunīhi bhikkhunīnaṃ kammaṃ kātun ti.
pli-tv-kd20:7.1.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhuniyo saṃghamajjhe bhaṇḍanajātā kalahajātā vivādāpannā aññamaññaṃ mukhasattīhi vitudantā viharanti
pli-tv-kd20:7.1.4: anujānāmi bhikkhave bhikkhūhi bhikkhunīnaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasametun ti.
pli-tv-kd20:7.1.5: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū bhikkhunīnaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasamenti,
pli-tv-kd20:7.1.6: tasmiṃ kho pana adhikaraṇe vinicchiyamāne dissanti bhikkhuniyo kammappattāyo pi āpattigāminiyo pi.
pli-tv-kd20:7.1.8: sādhu bhante ayyā 'va bhikkhunīnaṃ kammaṃ karontu, ayyā 'va bhikkhunīnaṃ āpattiṃ paṭigaṇhantu, evaṃ
pli-tv-kd20:7.1.9: hi bhagavatā paññattaṃ: bhikkhūhi bhikkhunīnaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasametabban ti.
pli-tv-kd20:7.1.11: anujānāmi bhikkhave bhikkhūhi bhikkhunīnaṃ kammaṃ ropetvā bhikkhunīnaṃ niyyādetuṃ
pli-tv-kd20:7.1.12: bhikkhunīhi bhikkhunīnaṃ kammaṃ kātuṃ, bhikkhūhi bhikkhunīnaṃ āpattiṃ ropetvā bhikkhunīnaṃ niyyādetuṃ bhikkhunīhi bhikkhunīnaṃ āpattiṃ paṭiggahetun ti. ||7||
pli-tv-kd20:8.1.1: tena kho pana samayena Uppalavaṇṇāya bhikkhuniyā antevāsibhikkhunī satta vassāni bhagavantaṃ anubaddhā hoti vinayaṃ pariyāpuṇantī,
pli-tv-kd20:8.1.5: atha kho tassā bhikkhuniyā etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd20:8.1.6: ahaṃ kho satta vassāni bhagavantaṃ anubaddhā vinayaṃ pariyāpuṇantī,
pli-tv-kd20:8.1.8: dukkaraṃ kho pana mātugāmena yāvajīvaṃ satthāraṃ anubandhituṃ.
pli-tv-kd20:8.1.9: kathaṃ nu kho mayā paṭipajjitabban ti.
pli-tv-kd20:8.1.10: atha kho sā bhikkhunī bhikkhunīnaṃ etam atthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-kd20:8.1.13: anujānāmi bhikkhave bhikkhūhi bhikkhunīnaṃ vinayaṃ vācetun ti. ||8||
pli-tv-kd20:9.1.1: atha kho bhagavā Vesāliyaṃ yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā yena Sāvatthi tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi,
pli-tv-kd20:9.1.2: anupubbena cārikañ caramāno yena Sāvatthi tad avasari.
pli-tv-kd20:9.1.3: tatra sudaṃ bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-kd20:9.1.4: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū bhikkhuniyo kaddamodakena osiñcanti
pli-tv-kd20:9.1.5: app eva nāma amhesu sārajjeyyun ti.
pli-tv-kd20:9.1.7: na bhikkhave bhikkhunā bhikkhuniyo kaddamodakena osiñcitabbā.
pli-tv-kd20:9.1.9: anujānāmi bhikkhave tassa bhikkhuno daṇḍakammaṃ kātun ti.
pli-tv-kd20:9.1.11: kin nu kho daṇḍakammaṃ kātabban ti.
pli-tv-kd20:9.1.13: avandiyo so bhikkhave bhikkhu bhikkhunīsaṃghena kātabbo 'ti.
pli-tv-kd20:9.1.14: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū kāyaṃ vivaritvā bhikkhunīnaṃ dassenti
pli-tv-kd20:9.1.15: ūruṃ vivaritvā bhikkhunīnaṃ dassenti aṅgajātaṃ vivaritvā bhikkhunīnaṃ dassenti bhikkhuniyo obhāsanti bhikkhunīhi saddhiṃ sampayojenti
pli-tv-kd20:9.1.16: app eva nāma amhesu sārajjeyyun ti.
pli-tv-kd20:9.1.18: na bhikkhave bhikkhunā kāyo vivaritvā bhikkhunīnaṃ dassetabbo, na ūru vivaritvā bhikkhunīnaṃ dassetabbo, na aṅgajātaṃ vivaritvā bhikkhunīnaṃ dassetabbaṃ, na bhikkhuniyo obhāsitabbā, na bhikkhunīhi saddhiṃ sampayojetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd20:9.1.20: anujānāmi bhikkhave tassa bhikkhuno daṇḍakammaṃ kātun ti.
pli-tv-kd20:9.1.22: kin nu kho daṇḍakammaṃ kātabban ti.
pli-tv-kd20:9.1.24: avandiyo so bhikkhave bhikkhu bhikkhunīsaṃghena kātabbo 'ti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd20:9.2.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo bhikkhū kaddamodakena osiñcanti
pli-tv-kd20:9.2.2: app eva nāma amhesu sārajjeyyun ti.
pli-tv-kd20:9.2.4: na bhikkhave bhikkhuniyā bhikkhū kaddamodakena osiñcitabbā.
pli-tv-kd20:9.2.6: anujānāmi bhikkhave tassā bhikkhuniyā daṇḍakammaṃ kātun ti.
pli-tv-kd20:9.2.8: kin nu kho daṇḍakammaṃ kātabban ti.
pli-tv-kd20:9.2.14: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo kāyaṃ vivaritvā bhikkhūnaṃ dassenti thanaṃ vivaritvā bhikkhūnaṃ dassenti ūruṃ vivaritvā bhikkhūnaṃ dassenti aṅgajātaṃ vivaritvā bhikkhūnaṃ dassenti bhikkhū obhāsanti bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ sampayojenti
pli-tv-kd20:9.2.15: app eva nāma amhesu sārajjeyyun ti.
pli-tv-kd20:9.2.17: na bhikkhave bhikkhuniyā kāyo vivaritvā bhikkhūnaṃ dassetabbo,
pli-tv-kd20:9.2.18: na thanaṃ vivaritvā bhikkhūnaṃ dassetabbaṃ, na ūru vivaritvā bhikkhūnaṃ dassetabbo, na aṅgajātaṃ vivaritvā bhikkhūnaṃ dassetabbaṃ, na bhikkhū obhāsitabbā, na bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ sampayojetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd20:9.2.20: anujānāmi bhikkhave tassā bhikkhuniyā daṇḍakammaṃ kātun ti.
pli-tv-kd20:9.2.22: kin nu kho daṇḍakammaṃ kātabban ti.
pli-tv-kd20:9.3.2: kappati nu kho ovādaṭhapitāya bhikkhuniyā saddhiṃ uposatho kātuṃ na nu kho kappatīti.
pli-tv-kd20:9.3.4: na bhikkhave ovādaṭhapitāya bhikkhuniyā saddhiṃ uposatho kātabbo yāva na taṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasantaṃ hotīti.
pli-tv-kd20:9.3.5: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Udāyi ovādaṃ ṭhapetvā cārikaṃ pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd20:9.3.7: kathaṃ hi nāma ayyo Udāyi ovādaṃ ṭhapetvā cārikaṃ pakkamissatīti.
pli-tv-kd20:9.3.9: na bhikkhave ovādaṃ ṭhapetvā cārikā pakkamitabbā.
pli-tv-kd20:9.3.11: tena kho pana samayena bālā avyattā ovādaṃ ṭhapenti.
pli-tv-kd20:9.3.13: na bhikkhave bālena avyattena ovādo ṭhapetabbo.
pli-tv-kd20:9.3.15: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū avatthusmiṃ akāraṇe ovādaṃ ṭhapenti.
pli-tv-kd20:9.3.17: na bhikkhave avatthusmiṃ akāraṇe ovādo ṭhapetabbo.
pli-tv-kd20:9.3.19: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū ovādaṃ ṭhapetvā vinicchayaṃ na denti.
pli-tv-kd20:9.3.21: na bhikkhave ovādaṃ ṭhapetvā vinicchayo na dātabbo.
pli-tv-kd20:9.4.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhuniyo ovādaṃ na gacchanti.
pli-tv-kd20:9.4.3: na bhikkhave bhikkhuniyā ovādo na gantabbo.
pli-tv-kd20:9.4.5: tena kho pana samayena sabbo bhikkhunīsaṃgho ovādaṃ gacchati.
pli-tv-kd20:9.4.7: jāyāyo imā imesaṃ, jāriyo imā imesaṃ, idān' ime imāhi saddhiṃ abhiramissantīti.
pli-tv-kd20:9.4.9: na bhikkhave sabbena bhikkhunīsaṃghena ovādo gantabbo.
pli-tv-kd20:9.4.11: anujānāmi bhikkhave catūhi pañcahi bhikkhunīhi ovādaṃ gantun ti.
pli-tv-kd20:9.4.12: tena kho pana samayena catasso pañca bhikkhuniyo ovādaṃ gacchanti.
pli-tv-kd20:9.4.13: manussā tath' eva ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-kd20:9.4.16: na bhikkhave catūhi pañcahi bhikkhunīhi ovādo gantabbo.
pli-tv-kd20:9.4.18: anujānāmi bhikkhave dve tisso bhikkhunīhi ovādaṃ gantuṃ:
pli-tv-kd20:9.4.19: ekaṃ bhikkhuṃ upasaṃkamitvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā pāde vanditvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā evam assa vacanīyo:
pli-tv-kd20:9.4.20: bhikkhunīsaṃgho ayya bhikkhusaṃghassa pāde vandati ovādūpasaṃkamanañ ca yācati,
pli-tv-kd20:9.4.21: labhatu kira ayya bhikkhunīsaṃgho ovādūpasaṃkamanan ti.
pli-tv-kd20:9.4.22: tena bhikkhunā pātimokkhuddesako upasaṃkamitvā evam assa vacanīyo:
pli-tv-kd20:9.4.23: bhikkhunīsaṃgho bhante bhikkhusaṃghassa pāde vandati ovādūpasaṃkamanañ ca yācati,
pli-tv-kd20:9.4.24: labhatu kira bhante bhikkhunīsaṃgho ovādūpasaṃkamanan ti.
pli-tv-kd20:9.4.27: sace hoti koci bhikkhu bhikkhunovādako sammato, pātimokkhuddesakena vattabbo:
pli-tv-kd20:9.4.28: itthannāmo bhikkhu bhikkhunovādako sammato, taṃ bhikkhunīsaṃgho upasaṃkamatū 'ti.
pli-tv-kd20:9.4.29: sace na hoti koci bhikkhu bhikkhunovādako sammato, pātimokkhuddesakena vattabbo:
pli-tv-kd20:9.4.30: ko āyasmā ussahati bhikkhuniyo ovaditun ti.
pli-tv-kd20:9.4.31: sace koci ussahati bhikkhuniyo ovadituṃ so ca hoti aṭṭhah' aṅgehi samannāgato, sammannitvā vattabbo:
pli-tv-kd20:9.4.32: itthannāmo bhikkhu bhikkhunovādako sammato, taṃ bhikkhunīsaṃgho upasaṃkamatū 'ti.
pli-tv-kd20:9.4.33: sace na koci ussahati bhikkhuniyo ovadituṃ, pātimokkhuddesakena vattabbo:
pli-tv-kd20:9.4.34: n' atthi koci bhikkhu bhikkhunovādako sammato, pāsādikena bhikkhunīsaṃgho sampādetū 'ti. ||4||
pli-tv-kd20:9.5.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū ovādaṃ na gaṇhanti.
pli-tv-kd20:9.5.5: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu bālo hoti,
pli-tv-kd20:9.5.14: anujānāmi bhikkhave ṭhapetvā bālaṃ avasesehi ovādaṃ gahetun ti.
pli-tv-kd20:9.5.15: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu gilāno hoti,
pli-tv-kd20:9.5.24: anujānāmi bhikkhave ṭhapetvā bālaṃ ṭhapetvā gilānaṃ avasesehi ovādaṃ gahetun ti.
pli-tv-kd20:9.5.25: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu gamiko hoti,
pli-tv-kd20:9.5.32: ṭhapetvā bālaṃ ṭhapetvā gilānaṃ avasesehi ovādo gahetabbo 'ti.
pli-tv-kd20:9.5.34: anujānāmi bhikkhave ṭhapetvā bālaṃ ṭhapetvā gilānaṃ ṭhapetvā gamikaṃ avasesehi ovādaṃ gahetun ti.
pli-tv-kd20:9.5.35: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu araññe viharati,
pli-tv-kd20:9.5.42: ṭhapetvā bālaṃ ṭhapetvā gilānaṃ ṭhapetvā gamikaṃ avasesehi ovādo gahetabbo 'ti.
pli-tv-kd20:9.5.44: anujānāmi bhikkhave āraññakena bhikkhunā ovādaṃ gahetuṃ saṃketaṃ ca kātuṃ
pli-tv-kd20:9.5.46: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū ovādaṃ gahetvā na ārocenti.
pli-tv-kd20:9.5.50: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū ovādaṃ gahetvā na paccāharanti.
pli-tv-kd20:9.5.54: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhuniyo saṃketaṃ na gacchanti.
pli-tv-kd20:9.5.56: na bhikkhave bhikkhuniyā saṃketaṃ na gantabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd20:10.1.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhuniyo dīghāni kāyabandhanāni dhārenti, teh' eva pāsuke namenti.
pli-tv-kd20:10.1.5: na bhikkhave bhikkhuniyā dīghaṃ kāyabandhanaṃ dhāretabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd20:10.1.7: anujānāmi bhikkhave bhikkhuniyā ekapariyākataṃ kāyabandhanaṃ. na ca tena pāsukā nametabbā.
pli-tv-kd20:10.1.9: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhuniyo vilivena paṭṭena pāsuke namenti,
pli-tv-kd20:10.1.22: na bhikkhave bhikkhuniyā vilivena paṭṭena pāsukā nametabbā, na cammapaṭṭena p. n., na dussapaṭṭena p. n., na dussaveṇiyā p. n., na dussavaṭṭiyā p. n., na colapaṭṭena p. n., na colaveṇiyā p. n., na colavaṭṭiyā p. n., na suttaveṇiyā p. n.,
pli-tv-kd20:10.2.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhuniyo aṭṭhillena jaghanaṃ ghaṃsāpenti,
pli-tv-kd20:10.2.2: gohanukena jaghanaṃ koṭṭāpenti, hatthaṃ koṭṭāpenti, hatthakocchaṃ koṭṭāpenti, pādaṃ koṭṭāpenti, pādakocchaṃ koṭṭāpenti, ūruṃ koṭṭāpenti, mukhaṃ koṭṭāpenti, dantamaṃsaṃ koṭṭāpenti.
pli-tv-kd20:10.2.6: na bhikkhave bhikkhuniyā aṭṭhillena jaghanaṃ ghaṃsāpetabbaṃ, na gohanukena jaghanaṃ koṭṭāpetabbaṃ, na hattho koṭṭāpetabbo, na hatthakoccho koṭṭāpetabbo, na pādo koṭṭāpetabbo, na pādakoccho koṭṭāpetabbo, na ūru koṭṭāpetabbo, na mukhaṃ koṭṭāpetabbaṃ,
pli-tv-kd20:10.3.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo mukhaṃ ālimpanti
pli-tv-kd20:10.3.2: mukhaṃ ummaddenti mukhaṃ cuṇṇenti manosilikāya mukhaṃ lañchenti aṅgarāgaṃ karonti mukharāgaṃ karonti aṅgarāgamukharāgaṃ karonti.
pli-tv-kd20:10.3.7: na mukhaṃ ummaddetabbaṃ, na mukhaṃ cuṇṇetabbaṃ, na manosilikāya mukhaṃ lañchetabbaṃ, na aṅgarāgo kātabbo, na mukharāgo kātabbo, na aṅgarāgamukharāgo kātabbo.
pli-tv-kd20:10.4.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo avaṅgaṃ karonti
pli-tv-kd20:10.4.2: visesakaṃ karonti olokanakena olokenti sāloke tiṭṭhanti
pli-tv-kd20:10.4.3: sanaccaṃ kārāpenti vesiṃ vuṭṭhāpenti pānāgāraṃ ṭhapenti sūnaṃ ṭhapenti āpaṇaṃ pasārenti vaḍḍhiṃ payojenti vaṇijjaṃ payojenti dāsaṃ upaṭṭhāpenti dāsiṃ upaṭṭhāpenti kammakaraṃ upaṭṭhāpenti kammakariṃ upaṭṭhāpenti tiracchānagataṃ upaṭṭhāpenti harītakapaṇṇikaṃ pakiṇanti namatakaṃ dhārenti.
pli-tv-kd20:10.4.8: na visesakaṃ kātabbaṃ, na olokanakena oloketabbaṃ, na sāloke tiṭṭhātabbaṃ, na sanaccaṃ kārāpetabbaṃ, na vesī vuṭṭhāpetabbā, na pānāgāraṃ ṭhapetabbaṃ, na sūnā ṭhapetabbā, na āpaṇo pasāretabbo, na vaḍḍhi payojetabbā, na vaṇijjā payojetabbā, na dāso upaṭṭhāpetabbo, na dāsī upaṭṭhāpetabbā, na kammakaro upaṭṭhāpetabbo, na kammakarī upaṭṭhāpetabbā, na tiracchānagato upaṭṭhāpetabbo, na harītakapaṇṇikaṃ pakiṇitabbaṃ, na namatakaṃ dhāretabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd20:10.5.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo sabbanīlakāni cīvarāni dhārenti
pli-tv-kd20:10.5.2: sabbapītakāni cīvarāni dhārenti sabbalohitakāni c. dh. sabbamañjeṭṭhakāni c. dh. sabbakaṇhāni c. dh. sabbamahāraṅgarattāni c. dh. sabbamahānāmarattāni c. dh. acchinnadasāni c. dh. dīghadasāni c. dh. pupphadasāni c. dh. phaṇadasāni c. dh. kañcukaṃ dhārenti tirīṭakaṃ dhārenti.
pli-tv-kd20:10.5.6: na bhikkhave bhikkhuniyā sabbanīlakāni cīvarāni dhāretabbāni, na sabbapītakāni cīvarāni dhāretabbāni, . . . na kañcukaṃ dhāretabbaṃ,
pli-tv-kd20:11.1.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarā bhikkhunī kālaṃ karontī evam āha:
pli-tv-kd20:11.1.2: mam' accayena mayhaṃ parikkhāro saṃghassa hotū 'ti.
pli-tv-kd20:11.1.3: tattha bhikkhū ca bhikkhuniyo ca vivadanti
pli-tv-kd20:11.1.6: bhikkhunī ce bhikkhave kālaṃ karontī evaṃ vadeyya:
pli-tv-kd20:11.1.7: mam' accayena mayhaṃ parikkhāro saṃghassa hotū 'ti, anissaro tattha bhikkhusaṃgho, bhikkhunīsaṃghass' eva taṃ.
pli-tv-kd20:11.1.10: anissaro tattha bhikkhusaṃgho, bhikkhunīsaṃghass' eva taṃ.
pli-tv-kd20:11.1.12: anissaro tattha bhikkhunīsaṃgho, bhikkhusaṃghass' eva taṃ.
pli-tv-kd20:11.1.16: añño ce bhikkhave koci kālaṃ karonto evaṃ vadeyya:
pli-tv-kd20:11.1.17: mam' accayena mayhaṃ parikkhāro saṃghassa hotū 'ti, anissaro tattha bhikkhunīsaṃgho, bhikkhusaṃghass' eva tan ti. ||11||
pli-tv-kd20:12.1.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarā purāṇa-Mallī bhikkhunīsu pabbajitā hoti,
pli-tv-kd20:12.1.2: sā rathikāya dubbalakaṃ bhikkhuṃ passitvā aṃsakūṭena pahāraṃ datvā pavaṭṭesi.
pli-tv-kd20:12.1.4: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhunī bhikkhussa pahāraṃ dassatīti.
pli-tv-kd20:12.1.6: na bhikkhave bhikkhuniyā bhikkhussa pahāro dātabbo.
pli-tv-kd20:12.1.8: anujānāmi bhikkhave bhikkhuniyā bhikkhuṃ passitvā dūrato 'va okkamitvā maggaṃ dātun ti. ||12||
pli-tv-kd20:13.1.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarā itthi pavutthapatikā jārena gabbhinī hoti,
pli-tv-kd20:13.1.2: sā gabbhaṃ pātetvā kulupikaṃ bhikkhuniṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd20:13.1.3: hand' ayye imaṃ gabbhaṃ pattena nīharā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd20:13.1.4: atha kho sā bhikkhunī taṃ gabbhaṃ patte pakkhipitvā saṃghāṭiyā paṭicchādetvā agamāsi.
pli-tv-kd20:13.1.5: tena kho pana samayena aññatarena piṇḍacārikena bhikkhunā samādānaṃ kataṃ hoti:
pli-tv-kd20:13.1.6: yāhaṃ paṭhamaṃ bhikkhaṃ labhissāmi na adatvā bhikkhussa vā bhikkhuniyā vā paribhuñjissāmīti.
pli-tv-kd20:13.1.7: atha kho so bhikkhu taṃ bhikkhuniṃ passitvā etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd20:13.1.11: tatiyam pi kho so bhikkhu taṃ bhikkhuniṃ etad avoca . . .
pli-tv-kd20:13.1.15: yāhaṃ paṭhamaṃ bhikkhaṃ labhissāmi na adatvā bhikkhussa vā bhikkhuniyā vā paribhuñjissāmīti.
pli-tv-kd20:13.1.17: atha kho sā bhikkhunī tena bhikkhunā nippīḷiyamānā nīharitvā pattaṃ dassesi:
pli-tv-kd20:13.1.20: atha kho so bhikkhu ujjhāyati khīyati vipāceti:
pli-tv-kd20:13.1.21: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhunī pattena gabbhaṃ nīharissatīti.
pli-tv-kd20:13.1.22: atha kho so bhikkhu bhikkhūnaṃ etam atthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-kd20:13.1.23: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-kd20:13.1.24: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhunī pattena gabbhaṃ nīharissatīti.
pli-tv-kd20:13.1.26: na bhikkhave bhikkhuniyā pattena gabbho nīharitabbo.
pli-tv-kd20:13.1.28: anujānāmi bhikkhave bhikkhuniyā bhikkhuṃ passitvā nīharitvā pattaṃ dassetun ti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd20:13.2.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo bhikkhuṃ passitvā parivattetvā pattamūlaṃ dassenti.
pli-tv-kd20:13.2.3: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo bhikkhuṃ passitvā parivattetvā pattamūlaṃ dassessantīti.
pli-tv-kd20:13.2.5: na bhikkhave bhikkhuniyā bhikkhuṃ passitvā parivattetvā pattamūlaṃ dassetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd20:13.2.7: anujānāmi bhikkhave bhikkhuniyā bhikkhuṃ passitvā ukkujjitvā pattaṃ dassetuṃ,
pli-tv-kd20:13.2.8: yañ ca patte āmisaṃ hoti tena ca bhikkhu nimantetabbo 'ti. ||2||13||
pli-tv-kd20:14.1.1: tena kho pana samayena Sāvatthiyaṃ rathikāya purisavyañjanaṃ chaḍḍitaṃ hoti,
pli-tv-kd20:14.1.5: atha kho tā bhikkhuniyo upassayaṃ gantvā bhikkhunīnaṃ etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd20:14.1.6: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā tā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-kd20:14.1.7: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo purisavyañjanaṃ upanijjhāyissantīti.
pli-tv-kd20:14.1.8: atha kho tā bhikkhuniyo bhikkhūnaṃ etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd20:15.1.1: tena kho pana samayena manussā bhikkhūnaṃ āmisaṃ denti,
pli-tv-kd20:15.1.4: kathaṃ hi nāma bhaddantā attano paribhogatthāya dinnaṃ aññesaṃ dassanti,
pli-tv-kd20:15.1.5: mayam ha na jānāma dānaṃ dātun ti.
pli-tv-kd20:15.1.7: na bhikkhave attano paribhogatthāya dinnaṃ aññesaṃ dātabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd20:15.1.9: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhūnaṃ āmisaṃ ussannaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-kd20:15.1.14: anujānāmi bhikkhave puggalikam pi dātun ti.
pli-tv-kd20:15.1.15: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhūnaṃ sannidhikataṃ āmisaṃ ussannaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-kd20:15.1.17: anujānāmi bhikkhave bhikkhūnaṃ sannidhiṃ bhikkhunīhi bhikkhūhi paṭiggahāpetvā paribhuñjitun ti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd20:15.2.1: tena kho pana samayena manussā bhikkhunīnaṃ āmisaṃ denti,
pli-tv-kd20:15.2.4: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo attano paribhogatthāya dinnaṃ aññesaṃ dassanti,
pli-tv-kd20:15.2.5: mayam ha na jānāma dānaṃ dātun ti.
pli-tv-kd20:15.2.7: na bhikkhave bhikkhuniyā attano paribhogatthāya dinnaṃ aññesaṃ dātabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd20:15.2.9: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhunīnaṃ āmisaṃ ussannaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-kd20:15.2.14: anujānāmi bhikkhave puggalikam pi dātun ti.
pli-tv-kd20:15.2.15: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhunīnaṃ sannidhikataṃ āmisaṃ ussannaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-kd20:15.2.17: anujānāmi bhikkhave bhikkhunīnaṃ sannidhiṃ bhikkhūhi bhikkhunīhi paṭiggahāpetvā paribhuñjitun ti. ||2||15||
pli-tv-kd20:16.1.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhūnaṃ senāsanaṃ ussannaṃ hoti, bhikkhunīnaṃ na hoti.
pli-tv-kd20:16.1.3: sādhu bhante ayyā amhākaṃ senāsanaṃ dentu tāvakālikan ti.
pli-tv-kd20:16.1.5: anujānāmi bhikkhave bhikkhunīnaṃ senāsanaṃ dātuṃ tāvakālikan ti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd20:16.2.1: tena kho pana samayena utuniyo bhikkhuniyo onaddhamañcaṃ onaddhapīṭhaṃ abhinisīdanti pi abhinipajjanti pi,
pli-tv-kd20:16.2.4: na bhikkhave bhikkhuniyā onaddhamañcaṃ onaddhapīṭhaṃ abhinisīditabbaṃ abhinipajjitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd20:16.2.5: yā abhinisīdeyya vā abhinipajjeyya vā, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-kd20:16.2.12: anujānāmi bhikkhave suttakena bandhitvā ūruyā bandhitun ti.
pli-tv-kd20:16.2.16: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo sabbakālaṃ kaṭisuttakaṃ dhārenti.
pli-tv-kd20:16.2.20: na bhikkhave bhikkhuniyā sabbakālaṃ kaṭisuttakaṃ dhāretabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd20:17.1.1: tena kho pana samayena upasampannāyo dissanti
pli-tv-kd20:17.1.2: animittāpi nimittamattāpi alohitāpi dhuvalohitāpi dhuvacolāpi paggharantī pi sikhariṇī pi itthipaṇḍikāpi vepurisikāpi sambhinnāpi ubhatovyañjanāpi.
pli-tv-kd20:17.1.4: anujānāmi bhikkhave upasampādentiyā catuvīsatiṃ antarāyike dhamme pucchituṃ.
pli-tv-kd20:17.1.6: na 'si animittā, na 'si nimittamattā, na 'si alohitā, na 'si dhuvalohitā, na 'si dhuvacolā, na 'si paggharantī, na 'si sikhariṇī, na 'si itthipaṇḍikā, na 'si vepurisikā, na 'si sambhinnā, na 'si ubhatovyañjanā,
pli-tv-kd20:17.1.9: manussāsi, itthi 'si, bhujissāsi, anaṇāsi, na 'si rājabhaṭī,
pli-tv-kd20:17.1.11: paripuṇṇavīsativassāsi, paripuṇṇan te pattacīvaraṃ, kiṃnāmāsi, kānāmā te pavattinīti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd20:17.2.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū bhikkhunīnaṃ antarāyike dhamme pucchanti,
pli-tv-kd20:17.2.2: upasampadāpekkhāyo vitthāyanti maṅkū honti na sakkonti vissajjetuṃ.
pli-tv-kd20:17.2.4: anujānāmi bhikkhave ekatoupasampannāya bhikkhunīsaṃghe visuddhāya bhikkhusaṃghe upasampadan ti.
pli-tv-kd20:17.2.5: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhuniyo ananusiṭṭhā upasampadāpekkhāyo antarāyike dhamme pucchanti.
pli-tv-kd20:17.2.6: upasampadāpekkhāyo vitthāyanti maṅkū honti na sakkonti vissajjetuṃ.
pli-tv-kd20:17.2.8: anujānāmi bhikkhave paṭhamaṃ anusāsitvā pacchā antarāyike dhamme pucchitun ti.
pli-tv-kd20:17.2.10: upasampadāpekkhāyo tath' eva vitthāyanti maṅkū honti na sakkonti vissajjetuṃ.
pli-tv-kd20:17.2.12: anujānāmi bhikkhave ekamantaṃ anusāsitvā saṃghamajjhe antarāyike dhamme pucchituṃ.
pli-tv-kd20:17.2.16: ayan te patto, ayaṃ saṃghāṭi, ayaṃ uttarāsaṅgo, ayaṃ antaravāsako, idaṃ saṃkacchikaṃ, ayaṃ udakasāṭikā,
pli-tv-kd20:17.3.2: anusiṭṭhā upasampadāpekkhāyo vitthāyanti maṅkū honti na sakkonti vissajjetuṃ.
pli-tv-kd20:17.3.6: anujānāmi bhikkhave vyattāya bhikkhuniyā paṭibalāya anusāsitun ti. ||3||
pli-tv-kd20:17.4.7: attanā vā attānaṃ sammannitabbaṃ parāya vā parā sammannitabbā.
pli-tv-kd20:17.4.8: kathañ ca attanā vā attānaṃ sammannitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd20:17.4.12: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ, ahaṃ itthannāmaṃ anusāseyyan ti.
pli-tv-kd20:17.4.14: kathañ ca parāya vā parā sammannitabbā.
pli-tv-kd20:17.4.18: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ, itthannāmā itthannāmaṃ anusāseyyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd20:17.5.1: tāya sammatāya bhikkhuniyā upasampadāpekkhā upasaṃkamitvā evam assa vacanīyā:
pli-tv-kd20:17.5.4: yaṃ jātaṃ taṃ saṃghamajjhe pucchante santaṃ atthīti vattabbaṃ, asantaṃ n' atthīti vattabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd20:17.5.5: mā kho vitthāsi, mā kho maṅku ahosi.
pli-tv-kd20:17.5.21: ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ kārāpetvā bhikkhunīnaṃ pāde vandāpetvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīdāpetvā añjaliṃ paggaṇhāpetvā upasampadaṃ yācāpetabbā:
pli-tv-kd20:17.5.23: ullumpatu maṃ ayye saṃgho anukampaṃ upādāya,
pli-tv-kd20:17.5.24: dutiyam pi ayye . . ., tatiyam pi ayye saṃghaṃ upasampadaṃ yācāmi,
pli-tv-kd20:17.5.25: ullumpatu maṃ ayye saṃgho anukampaṃ upādāyā
pli-tv-kd20:17.6.4: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ, ahaṃ itthannāmaṃ antarāyike dhamme puccheyyan ti.
pli-tv-kd20:17.6.7: yaṃ jātaṃ taṃ pucchāmi. santaṃ atthīti vattabbaṃ, asantaṃ n' atthīti vattabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd20:17.7.4: parisuddhā antarāyikehi dhammehi, paripuṇṇ' assā pattacīvaraṃ.
pli-tv-kd20:17.7.5: itthannāmā saṃghaṃ upasampadaṃ yācati itthannāmāya ayyāya pavattiniyā.
pli-tv-kd20:17.7.6: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ, saṃgho itthannāmaṃ upasampādeyya itthannāmāya ayyāya pavattiniyā.
pli-tv-kd20:17.7.12: saṃgho itthannāmaṃ upasampādeti itthannāmāya ayyāya pavattiniyā.
pli-tv-kd20:17.7.13: yassā ayyāya khamati itthannāmāya upasampadā itthannāmāya ayyāya pavattiniyā sā tuṇh' assa,
pli-tv-kd20:17.7.24: upasampannā saṃghena itthannāmā itthannāmāya ayyāya pavattiniyā.
pli-tv-kd20:17.8.1: tāvad eva ādāya bhikkhusaṃghaṃ upasaṃkamitvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ kārāpetvā bhikkhūnaṃ pāde vandāpetvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīdāpetvā añjaliṃ paggaṇhāpetvā upasampadaṃ yācāpetabbā:
pli-tv-kd20:17.8.2: ahaṃ ayyā itthannāmā itthannāmāya ayyāya upasampadāpekkhā
pli-tv-kd20:17.8.5: ullumpatu maṃ ayyā saṃgho anukampaṃ upādāya.
pli-tv-kd20:17.8.8: dutiyam pi . . ., ahaṃ ayyā itthannāmā . . . visuddhā tatiyam pi ayyā saṃghaṃ upasampadaṃ yācāmi,
pli-tv-kd20:17.8.9: ullumpatu maṃ ayyā saṃgho anukampaṃ upādāyā
pli-tv-kd20:17.8.18: itthannāmā saṃghaṃ upasampadaṃ yācati itthannāmāya pavattiniyā.
pli-tv-kd20:17.8.19: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ, saṃgho itthannāmaṃ upasampādeyya itthannāmāya pavattiniyā.
pli-tv-kd20:17.8.26: yassāyasmato khamati itthannāmāya upasampadā itthannāmāya pavattiniyā so tuṇh' assa.
pli-tv-kd20:17.8.39: tāvad eva chāyā metabbā, utupamāṇaṃ ācikkhitabbaṃ, divasabhāgo ācikkhitabbo, saṃgīti ācikkhitabbā, bhikkhuniyo vattabbā:
pli-tv-kd20:17.8.40: imissā tayo ca nissaye aṭṭha ca akaraṇīyāni acikkheyyāthā 'ti. ||8||17||
pli-tv-kd20:18.1.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhuniyo bhattagge āsanaṃ saṃkāyantiyo kālaṃ vītināmesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd20:18.1.3: anujānāmi bhikkhave aṭṭhannaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ yathāvuḍḍhaṃ, avasesānaṃ yathāgatikaṃ.
pli-tv-kd20:18.1.5: bhagavatā anuññātaṃ aṭṭhannaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ yathāvuḍḍhaṃ avasesānaṃ yathāgatikan ti
pli-tv-kd20:18.1.6: sabbattha aṭṭhā 'va bhikkhuniyo yathāvuḍḍhaṃ paṭibāhanti avasesāyo yathāgatikaṃ.
pli-tv-kd20:18.1.8: anujānāmi bhikkhave bhattagge aṭṭhannaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ yathāvuḍḍhaṃ avasesānaṃ yathāgatikaṃ,
pli-tv-kd20:19.1.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhuniyo na pavārenti.
pli-tv-kd20:19.1.5: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhuniyo attanā pavāretvā bhikkhusaṃghe na pavārenti.
pli-tv-kd20:19.1.7: na bhikkhave bhikkhuniyā attanā pavāretvā bhikkhusaṃghe na pavāretabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd20:19.1.9: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhuniyo bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ ekato pavārentiyo kolāhalaṃ akaṃsu.
pli-tv-kd20:19.1.11: na bhikkhave bhikkhuniyā bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ ekato pavāretabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd20:19.1.13: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhuniyo purebhattaṃ pavārentiyo kālaṃ vītināmesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd20:19.1.18: anujānāmi bhikkhave ajjatanā pavāretvā aparajju bhikkhusaṃghaṃ pavāretun ti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd20:19.2.1: tena kho pana samayena sabbo bhikkhunīsaṃgho pavārento kolāhalaṃ akāsi.
pli-tv-kd20:19.2.3: anujānāmi bhikkhave ekaṃ bhikkhuniṃ viyattaṃ paṭibalaṃ sammannituṃ
pli-tv-kd20:19.2.6: paṭhamaṃ bhikkhunī yācitabbā, yācitvā vyattāya bhikkhuniyā paṭibalāya saṃgho ñāpetabbo:
pli-tv-kd20:19.2.8: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ, saṃgho itthannāmaṃ bhikkhuniṃ sammanneyya bhikkhunīsaṃghassa atthāya bhikkhusaṃghaṃ pavāretuṃ.
pli-tv-kd20:19.2.11: saṃgho itthannāmaṃ bhikkhuniṃ sammannati bhikkhunīsaṃghassa atthāya bhikkhusaṃghaṃ pavāretuṃ.
pli-tv-kd20:19.2.12: yassā ayyāya khamati itthannāmāya bhikkhuniyā sammuti bhikkhunīsaṃghassa atthāya bhikkhusaṃghaṃ pavāretuṃ sā tuṇh' assa.
pli-tv-kd20:19.2.14: sammatā saṃghena itthannāmā bhikkhunī bhikkhunīsaṃghassa atthāya bhikkhusaṃghaṃ pavāretuṃ.
pli-tv-kd20:19.3.1: tāya sammatāya bhikkhuniyā bhikkhunīsaṃghaṃ ādāya bhikkhusaṃghaṃ upasaṃkamitvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā bhikkhūnaṃ pāde vanditvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā evam assa vacanīyo:
pli-tv-kd20:19.3.3: diṭṭhena vā sutena vā parisaṅkāya vā,
pli-tv-kd20:19.3.4: vadatu ayyā bhikkhusaṃgho bhikkhunīsaṃghaṃ anukampaṃ upādāya, passanto paṭikarissati.
pli-tv-kd20:19.3.6: tatiyam pi ayyā bhikkhunīsaṃgho bhikkhusaṃghaṃ pavāreti . . .
pli-tv-kd20:20.1.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhuniyo bhikkhūnaṃ uposathaṃ ṭhapenti pavāraṇaṃ ṭhapenti savacanīyaṃ karonti anuvādaṃ ṭhapenti okāsaṃ kārenti codenti sārenti.
pli-tv-kd20:20.1.3: na bhikkhave bhikkhuniyā bhikkhussa uposatho ṭhapetabbo:
pli-tv-kd20:20.1.24: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū bhikkhunīnaṃ uposathaṃ ṭhapenti . . . sārenti.
pli-tv-kd20:20.1.26: anujānāmi bhikkhave bhikkhunā bhikkhuniyā uposathaṃ ṭhapetuṃ:
pli-tv-kd20:21.1.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo yānena yāyanti
pli-tv-kd20:21.1.2: itthiyuttena pi purisantarena purisayuttena pi itthantarena.
pli-tv-kd20:21.1.8: tena kho pana samayena aññatarā bhikkhunī gilānā hoti, na sakkoti padasā gantuṃ.
pli-tv-kd20:21.1.12: itthiyuttan nu kho purisayuttan nu kho 'ti.
pli-tv-kd20:21.1.14: anujānāmi bhikkhave itthiyuttaṃ purisayuttaṃ hatthavaṭṭakan ti.
pli-tv-kd20:21.1.15: tena kho pana samayena aññatarāya bhikkhuniyā yānugghātena bāḷhataraṃ aphāsu ahosi.
pli-tv-kd20:22.1.1: tena kho pana samayena Aḍḍhakāsī gaṇikā bhikkhunīsu pabbajitā hoti,
pli-tv-kd20:22.1.11: kathaṃ nu kho mayā paṭipajjitabban ti.
pli-tv-kd20:22.1.12: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd20:22.1.13: anujānāmi bhikkhave dūtena pi upasampādetun ti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd20:22.2.9: na bhikkhave bālāya avyattāya dūtena upasampādetabbā.
pli-tv-kd20:22.2.11: anujānāmi bhikkhave vyattāya bhikkhuniyā paṭibalāya dūtena upasampādetuṃ. ||2||
pli-tv-kd20:22.3.1: tāya dūtāya bhikkhuniyā saṃghaṃ upasaṃkamitvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā bhikkhūnaṃ pāde vanditvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā evam assa vacanīyo:
pli-tv-kd20:22.3.6: ullumpatu taṃ ayyā saṃgho anukampaṃ upādāya.
pli-tv-kd20:22.3.10: dutiyam pi ayyā itthannāmā saṃghaṃ upasampadaṃ yācati . . .
pli-tv-kd20:22.3.15: tatiyam pi ayyā itthannāmā saṃghaṃ upasampadaṃ yācati . . .
pli-tv-kd20:22.3.22: itthannāmā saṃghaṃ upasampadaṃ yācati itthannāmāya pavattiniyā.
pli-tv-kd20:22.3.23: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ, saṃgho itthannāmaṃ upasampādeyya itthannāmāya pavattiniyā.
pli-tv-kd20:22.3.31: yassāyasmato khamati itthannāmāya upasampadā itthannāmāya pavattiniyā, so tuṇh' assa.
pli-tv-kd20:22.3.45: tāvad eva chāyā metabbā, utupamāṇaṃ ācikkhitabbaṃ, divasabhāgo ācikkhitabbo, saṃgīti ācikkhitabbā, bhikkhuniyo vattabbā:
pli-tv-kd20:22.3.46: tassā tayo ca nissaye aṭṭha ca akaraṇīyāni ācikkheyyāthā 'ti. ||3||22||
pli-tv-kd20:23.1.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhuniyo araññe viharanti,
pli-tv-kd20:24.1.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarena upāsakena bhikkhunīsaṃghassa uddosito dinno hoti.
pli-tv-kd20:24.1.12: anujānāmi bhikkhave puggalikam pi kātun ti. ||24||
pli-tv-kd20:25.1.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarā itthi sannisinnagabbhā bhikkhunīsu pabbajitā hoti,
pli-tv-kd20:25.1.3: atha kho tassā bhikkhuniyā etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd20:25.1.4: kathan nu kho mayā imasmiṃ dārake paṭipajjitabban ti.
pli-tv-kd20:25.1.6: anujānāmi bhikkhave posetuṃ yāva so dārako viññutaṃ pāpuṇātīti.
pli-tv-kd20:25.1.7: atha kho tassā bhikkhuniyā etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd20:25.1.8: mayā ca na labbhā ekikāya vatthuṃ, aññāya ca bhikkhuniyā na labbhā dārakena saha vatthuṃ. kathaṃ nu kho mayā paṭipajjitabban ti.
pli-tv-kd20:25.1.10: anujānāmi bhikkhave ekaṃ bhikkhuniṃ sammannitvā tassā bhikkhuniyā dutiyaṃ dātuṃ.
pli-tv-kd20:25.1.12: paṭhamaṃ bhikkhunī yācitabbā, yācitvā vyattāya bhikkhuniyā paṭibalāya saṃgho ñāpetabbo:
pli-tv-kd20:25.1.14: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ, saṃgho itthannāmaṃ bhikkhuniṃ sammanneyya itthannāmāya bhikkhuniyā dutiyaṃ.
pli-tv-kd20:25.1.17: saṃgho itthannāmaṃ bhikkhuniṃ sammannati itthannāmāya bhikkhuniyā dutiyaṃ.
pli-tv-kd20:25.1.18: yassā ayyāya khamati itthannāmāya bhikkhuniyā sammuti itthannāmāya bhikkhuniyā dutiyāya, sā tuṇh' assa.
pli-tv-kd20:25.1.20: sammatā saṃghena itthannāmā bhikkhunī itthannāmāya bhikkhuniyā dutiyā.
pli-tv-kd20:25.2.1: atha kho tassā dutiyikāya bhikkhuniyā etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd20:25.2.2: kathan nu kho mayā imasmiṃ dārake paṭipajjitabban ti.
pli-tv-kd20:25.2.4: anujānāmi bhikkhave ṭhapetvā sāgāraṃ yathā aññe purise paṭipajjanti evaṃ tasmiṃ dārake paṭipajjitun ti. ||2||
pli-tv-kd20:25.3.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarā bhikkhunī garudhammaṃ ajjhāpannā hoti mānattacārinī.
pli-tv-kd20:25.3.2: atha kho tassā bhikkhuniyā etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd20:25.3.3: mayā ca na labbhā ekikāya vatthuṃ, aññāya ca bhikkhuniyā na labbhā saha mayā vatthuṃ. kathaṃ nu kho mayā paṭipajjitabban ti.
pli-tv-kd20:25.3.5: anujānāmi bhikkhave ekaṃ bhikkhuniṃ sammannitvā tassā bhikkhuniyā dutiyaṃ dātuṃ.
pli-tv-kd20:26.1.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarā bhikkhunī sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya vibbhami,
pli-tv-kd20:26.1.2: sā puna paccāgantvā bhikkhuniyo upasampadaṃ yāci.
pli-tv-kd20:26.1.5: yad eva sā vibbhantā, tad eva sā abhikkhunīti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd20:26.2.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarā bhikkhunī sakāsāvā titthāyatanaṃ saṃkami,
pli-tv-kd20:26.2.2: sā puna paccāgantvā bhikkhuniyo upasampadaṃ yāci.
pli-tv-kd20:26.2.4: yā sā bhikkhave bhikkhunī sakāsāvā titthāyatanaṃ saṃkantā, sā āgatā na upasampādetabbā 'ti. ||2||26||
pli-tv-kd20:27.1.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhuniyo purisehi abhivādanaṃ kesacchedanaṃ nakhacchedanaṃ vaṇapaṭikammaṃ kukkuccāyantā na sādiyanti.
pli-tv-kd20:27.2.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhuniyo pallaṅkena nisīdanti paṇhisamphassaṃ sādiyantā.
pli-tv-kd20:27.2.5: tena kho pana samayena aññatarā bhikkhunī gilānā hoti,
pli-tv-kd20:27.2.6: tassā vinā pallaṅkena na phāsu hoti.
pli-tv-kd20:27.3.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhuniyo vaccakuṭiyā vaccaṃ karonti,
pli-tv-kd20:27.3.2: chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo tatth' eva gabbaṃ pātenti.
pli-tv-kd20:27.3.4: na bhikkhave bhikkhuniyā vaccakuṭiyā vacco kātabbo.
pli-tv-kd20:27.3.6: anujānāmi bhikkhave heṭṭhāvivaṭe uparipaṭicchanne vaccaṃ kātun ti. ||3||
pli-tv-kd20:27.4.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhuniyo cuṇṇena nahāyanti.
pli-tv-kd20:27.4.8: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhuniyo vāsitikāya mattikāya nahāyanti.
pli-tv-kd20:27.4.12: na bhikkhave bhikkhuniyā vāsitikāya mattikāya nahāyitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd20:27.4.15: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhuniyo jantāghare nahāyantiyo kolāhalaṃ akaṃsu.
pli-tv-kd20:27.4.19: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhuniyo paṭisote nahāyanti dhārāsamphassaṃ sādiyantā.
pli-tv-kd20:27.4.23: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhuniyo atitthe nahāyanti,
pli-tv-kd20:27.4.28: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhuniyo purisatitthe nahāyanti.
pli-tv-kd20:27.4.34: anujānāmi bhikkhave mahilātitthe nahāyitun ti. ||4||27|| bhikkhunīkhandhakaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ dasamaṃ.
